query: After the theme change the cards are invisible and the shell looks wallpaper-tinted.
reason: Painted-output defect that markup review would miss.
expected_routing: Verify the painted result in the running app at 200 percent scale, check brush layering and translucency, and confirm the exe timestamp before trusting what is on screen.

query: The app will not start since I added the new palette.
reason: Resources that do not resolve at parse time fail app start, not one control.
expected_routing: Make the palette resolvable at parse time and verify the app launches in both themes.

query: The scan page list collapses to nothing on my machine.
reason: Star-sizing starvation at 200 percent scale inside a scrollable page.
expected_routing: Give the list Min/MaxHeight inside the scrollable page and verify every page at 200 percent.

query: Add an ETA to the download progress.
reason: Progress honesty rule - report the measured rate rather than invent an ETA.
expected_routing: Report the measured rate, show an ETA only where the data supports it, and keep pause, resume, cancel, retry and reveal available.
